primary_goal: Reproduce and improve the original Figure 5 instantaneous neural-to-joint-angle decoding result on all five imaging mice, paired M1/S1 sessions, 24 joints and 50 original held-out fits per session. Reproduction assesses complete source output families and required decoder companions against qualified references. Improvement means meaningful candidate-versus-author variance-explained gains on the same original inputs, folds and reductions. Separate intervention biology remains versioned context.
primary_scope: Explicit versioned selection: the original Figure 5 instantaneous RADICaL neural-to-24-joint-angle decoding result for M1 and S1, including complete source scores/reductions, original prediction/trajectory outputs and relevant decoder companions. Reproduction and improvement share this computational result. Separate M1-fl intervention biology is retained outside this primary.
retained_secondary_scope: The prior broad M1/S1 neural-decoding and two-VGAT-ChR2-mouse M1-fl intervention finding remains preserved at the exact base commit and unchanged canonical scientific contracts. Intervention contact/trajectory evidence is separately retained, not a prerequisite or target to maximize for this selected Figure 5 result. Conditional successful-trial histograms are not unconditional contact probabilities. Held-animal evaluation and local phase-template gains remain extensions/calibration; no decoder gain establishes intervention, whole-paper or current-SOTA superiority.
selection_reason: Explicit user-authorized original-result selection for both outcomes. This deliberately changes the old broader biological primary; it does not claim that primary was satisfied.

common_original_anchors.split: Preserve five repetitions of ten source trial partitions and all 50 held-out fits per session. Models 1-10 hold permutation residues 1-9 then 0; bind original trial order, complementary train/test identities and once-per-repeat coverage. Seed 240926 alone is insufficient because PCA and six source model configurations advance shared RNG. No newly chosen split substitutes.
common_original_anchors.inputs: Original instantaneous RADICaL rates from the top 100 source lift-modulated cells predict all 24 joint angles. Bind original ZETA cell selection, observation horizon and feature ordering. Candidate methods may improve the decoder but may not gain extra neurons, biological observations or target exposure. Relevant author alternative/control branches keep their distinct original inputs.
common_original_anchors.preprocessing: Preserve source joint-angle interpolation and 15-ms Gaussian smoothing, lift-locked -100 to +400 ms on the 10-ms grid (51 timepoints), unsmoothed RADICaL rates and pre-CV PCA retaining 90% of neuron count. Authenticate source ordering and exposure of ZETA/PCA instead of silently substituting train-only processing or permitting extra test-target access; controls retain branch-specific processing.
common_original_anchors.metric: Per joint and original fit, VE = 1 - Var(y - yhat)/Var(y), using MATLAB sample-variance semantics over concatenated held-out trial timepoints. Retain negative VE and resolve source zero-variance handling. This is not SSE/SST R-squared; constant prediction offsets leave VE unchanged. Exact complete numeric references and qualified agreement/improvement rules remain unresolved.
common_original_anchors.aggregation: Preserve the complete 5-mouse x 2-area x 50-fit x 24-joint panel. plotVEAll takes median over 50 fits per joint, then median of those joint medians for proximal joints 1-7 and distal joints 8-24 within each mouse/area. Compare differences of original summaries, not median paired-score differences or a pooled scalar. Keep all four area/group outputs, mouse pairing and companions; favorable subsets cannot win.

Justify numerical reproduction tolerance and meaningful complete-family improvement/uncertainty under five paired mice and dependent joints/folds; no arbitrary scalar, any-positive-delta or significance-maximization rule.

Bind protected source-compatible per-fit execution, common scientific input/exposure and official-code allowlists, independent verification and cumulative budgets. Existing scorer/exporter code is not an admitted end-to-end runtime.
